description: This file defines a React functional component named 'UpgradeNow' that manages UI logic and rendering for prompting users to upgrade or purchase features within a web application. It interacts with application state and controllers to determine whether to display the call-to-action (CTA) and handles user interactions such as button clicks.

methods.name: UpgradeNow
methods.description: React component that renders a CTA button for upgrading or purchasing features based on user subscription status and application capabilities.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Event handler for the button click, initiates either showing a premium modal or opening the purchase flow depending on the user's account and platform status.
